title: Construction Laborers
description: Perform tasks involving physical labor at construction sites. May operate hand and power tools of all types: air hammers, earth tampers, cement mixers, small mechanical hoists, surveying and measuring equipment, and a variety of other equipment and instruments. May clean and prepare sites, dig trenches, set braces to support the sides of excavations, erect scaffolding, and clean up rubble, debris, and other waste materials. May assist other craft workers.

tasks.text: Tend pumps, compressors, or generators to provide power for tools, machinery, or equipment or to heat or move materials, such as asphalt.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on pump and compressor operation

dwas.name: Operate pumps or compressors.

tasks.text: Lubricate, clean, or repair machinery, equipment, or tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

dwas.name: Clean equipment or facilities.
Maintain construction tools or equipment.

tasks.text: Signal equipment operators to facilitate alignment, movement, or adjustment of machinery, equipment, or materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Directing equipment operators via physical signals

dwas.name: Signal equipment operators to indicate proper equipment positioning.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Read plans, instructions, or specifications to determine work activities.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Measure, mark, or record openings or distances to layout areas where construction work will be performed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical site dimension measurement

dwas.name: Measure work site dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.text: Clean or prepare construction sites to eliminate possible hazards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor

dwas.name: Clean work sites.

tasks.text: Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, or compact and level earth to grade specifications, using picks, shovels, pneumatic tampers, or rakes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Dig holes or trenches.
Compact materials to create level bases.

tasks.text: Load, unload, or identify building materials, machinery, or tools, distributing them to the appropriate locations, according to project plans or specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of construction materials on site

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.
Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Position, join, align, or seal structural components, such as concrete wall sections or pipes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning structural components is physical labor

dwas.name: Position structural components.
Install plumbing or piping.

tasks.text: Perform site activities required of green certified construction practices, such as implementing waste management procedures, identifying materials for reuse, or installing erosion or sedimentation control mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Green structural installation is hands-on

dwas.name: Install green structural components, equipment or systems.

tasks.text: Control traffic passing near, in, or around work zones.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Directing live traffic requires physical presence

dwas.name: Direct vehicle traffic.

tasks.text: Install sewer, water, or storm drain pipes, using pipe-laying machinery or laser guidance equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on plumbing in structures

dwas.name: Install plumbing or piping.

tasks.text: Operate or maintain air monitoring or other sampling devices in confined or hazardous environments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Air sampling requires on-site instrument operation

dwas.name: Test air quality at work sites.

tasks.text: Smooth or finish freshly poured cement or concrete, using floats, trowels, screeds, or powered cement finishing tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Skilled hand finishing of concrete surfaces

dwas.name: Finish concrete surfaces.

tasks.text: Erect or dismantle scaffolding, shoring, braces, traffic barricades, ramps, or other temporary structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

dwas.name: Assemble temporary equipment or structures.
Dismantle equipment or temporary structures.

tasks.text: Provide assistance to craft workers, such as carpenters, plasterers, or masons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Spray materials, such as water, sand, steam, vinyl, paint, or stucco, through hoses to clean, coat, or seal surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.
Apply paint to surfaces.
Apply sealants or other protective coatings.

tasks.text: Raze buildings or salvage useful materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of worn materials

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Mop, brush, or spread paints, cleaning solutions, or other compounds over surfaces to clean them or to provide protection.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.
Apply paint to surfaces.

tasks.text: Position or dismantle forms for pouring concrete, using saws, hammers, nails, or bolts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement and alignment of forms on site

dwas.name: Position construction forms or molds.

tasks.text: Grind, scrape, sand, or polish surfaces, such as concrete, marble, terrazzo, or wood flooring, using abrasive tools or machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.text: Place, consolidate, or protect case-in-place concrete or masonry structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on placement of protective coverings

dwas.name: Protect structures or surfaces near work areas to avoid damage.
Install masonry materials.

tasks.text: Mix ingredients to create compounds for covering or cleaning surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.

tasks.text: Mix, pour, or spread concrete, using portable cement mixers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.
Pour materials into or on designated areas.
Spread concrete or other aggregate mixtures.

tasks.text: Operate jackhammers or drills to break up concrete or pavement.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Breaking rock and concrete is physical labor

dwas.name: Break up rock, asphalt, or concrete.

tasks.text: Apply caulking compounds by hand or caulking guns to protect against entry of water or air.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying sealants requires hands-on coating

dwas.name: Apply sealants or other protective coatings.

tasks.text: Tend machines that pump concrete, grout, cement, sand, plaster, or stucco through spray guns for application to ceilings or walls.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on pump and compressor operation

dwas.name: Operate pumps or compressors.
